description: Local-only PostgreSQL plus MinIO recovery-set drill proving that one opaque synthetic recovery-set digest is captured in both database state and exact-version object backup metadata, then restored into separate targets and verified equal. A deliberate one-sided digest mismatch must fail closed. This is not PITR, time-skew measurement, independent provider retention or production-equivalent recovery evidence.

requiredSteps: create clean source and target PostgreSQL databases
apply complete canonical migration sequence to source database
create one opaque synthetic recovery-set digest
persist a synthetic account-control marker derived from the recovery-set digest
create versioned source backup and restore MinIO buckets
write a synthetic object carrying the same recovery-set digest in metadata
create a PostgreSQL logical dump and copy the exact selected object version into backup storage
destroy the source database marker and all source object versions before restore verification
restore the PostgreSQL dump into the separate target database
restore the exact backup object version into the restore bucket
derive the recovery-set digest independently from restored database and object state
require restored database and object recovery-set digests to be identical
run a deliberate one-sided digest mismatch comparison and require fail-closed rejection
write privacy-safe exact-source evidence containing only digests and bounded counts
successCriteria: canonical migration count matches the migration lifecycle contract
database dump and restore complete without ignored errors
source object is explicitly version-addressed and source versions are removed before recovery
exact backup object version checksum survives restore
restored database marker maps to the expected recovery-set digest
restored object metadata carries the expected recovery-set digest
database and object recovery-set digests are equal
deliberate one-sided digest mismatch is rejected
no production credentials traffic or evidence are used
abortCriteria: PostgreSQL or object endpoint is non-local
source and target database identity are ambiguous
migration dump restore or object-version operation fails
database or object recovery-set binding is missing
database and object recovery-set digests differ
raw database URL credential bucket object key version identifier or synthetic marker would enter evidence
